implementation_subject: fix(bridge): reject aliased output paths before writes
evidence_status: Local, reproducible implementation evidence only; not a publisher signature, zero-knowledge proof, remote synchronization receipt or universal filesystem race defense.

criteria.evidence: Resolved-path preflight rejects parent/.., final and dangling symlinks, symlinked parents and direct spellings before StateLock, polling, execution or writes. Real cases: poll_parent, wave_parent, execution_parent, dangling_symlink, symlinked_parent and dot_control.

Existing Unix outputs are keyed by device/inode; the hardlink_plan_report case rejects --out with --wave-out while preserving both sentinel names and their shared identity. Windows uses volume serial/file index when both are available; other filesystems retain resolved-path checks only.

Six attack cases produce old exit=0 and new exit=2. The old binary replaces ledgers with poll, wave or execution documents; the new binary leaves every declared before/after snapshot equal and creates no lock.
Dangling-symlink and hard-link attacks are rejected before first write. The hardlink sentinel SHA-256 remains b5f7e7d285029324d9b3acae19cc05099271454ac98bfc059a92b0581625cd51 at both names.

StateLock resolves final symlink targets before deriving the sidecar; direct and alias acquisition contend with WouldBlock. distinct_control succeeds on both binaries and produces byte-identical ledger, report and plan artifacts.

verify-path-python.py independently uses realpath/samefile/stat and recomputes every recorded after-state from the filesystem. Self-test passes five path known answers and rejects five fake reports before adjudicating the eight-case report.

The implementation commit archive has no .git and was built with an initially absent CARGO_TARGET_DIR. build-all exited 0; 104 Rust tests passed. The resulting clean binary repeated all eight differentials and the independent verifier passed.

development_corrections.record: The initial ./ alias probe was rejected by the baseline, so dot-only spelling was not misreported as a vulnerability. Existing-subdirectory/.. and link probes established the actual gap.

The first implementation failed dangling_symlink_alias_is_rejected_before_target_creation: 41 passed, 1 failed. Canonicalize fallback had treated the dangling link name as a new file. Layered symlink redirection with a depth bound fixed it; the complete 104-test suite then passed.

The independent verifier initially rejected hardlink_plan_report because it incorrectly demanded --state in a --out/--wave-out diagnostic. Only the label expectation was corrected; the same raw development report then passed, followed by a fresh clean-binary differential.

not_proven: Preflight is not race-free against hostile pathname mutation after validation and does not confine non-cooperating writers.
Cross-process hard-link aliases do not obtain a universal persistent inode lock; no distributed lock, CAS, WAL, fsync or crash-power-loss durability claim is added.

No remote push, external CI, publisher authentication, cisvr ACK, KEY-SYNC-01, QF-OS/QIOS canonical compatibility, zero-knowledge proof or distributed exactly-once claim follows from this local evidence.
